newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman ups Standard Chartered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman ups Standard Chartered.

text.p: Banking group Standard Chartered Plc was raised to "buy" from "outperform" at Lehman Brothers following its recent results for 1996, the investment bank said on Friday.
In a research note, analyst Robert Law at the brokerage said the results showed the company's ability to sustain returns on attractive volume growth.
Assuming ten percent growth, Law said the stock would be offering annualised returns of as much as 15 percent on the current share price.
Standard shares were up 23p at 842 by 1425 GMT, after earlier reaching a record 829p -- surpassing the previous peak of 829p set February 10.
